lines.en: I walk swinging two long arms.
My body is wrapped in cloth.
I slip out of the jungle.
Long arms swinging, I walk.

lines.zh: 我的手臂几乎碰到地面。
lines.en: My arms nearly touch the ground.

lines.zh: 我从末地岛屿的边上走过。
lines.en: I walk the edge of an End island.
The grass bends under my feet.
I copy others. The hopping looks right.
I swing my head side to side.
I circle a large tree.
I creep through the grass, hunched.
I stop and scratch my head.
I crouch, hands on the ground.
I'm sizing up the trees.
My cloth flaps in the wind.
I crouch and hug my knees.
The jungle is close and damp.
I open and close my fingers slowly.
I copy anyone; do not trust your eyes.
Sun falls through the leaves.
I just want somewhere quiet.
My fingers are very nimble.
I've been here a while.
When the wind blows, I turn my head.
I pull the cloth up a bit.
Counting the birds in the tree.

lines.zh: 你看见我了吗？我不太想打架。
lines.en: Did you see me? I would rather not fight.
I'd rather not fight.
You've got something in your hand.

lines.zh: 我张开手表示没有恶意。
lines.en: I spread my hands to show no harm.
Don't say that name.
Maybe I shouldn't be here.
You look like you can fight.
I'm a little nervous inside.
I want to remember what you look like.

lines.zh: 你会不会告诉我该去哪？
lines.en: Could you tell me where to go?
Is anyone else around here?
My name isn't important.

lines.zh: 我把两条长臂藏在身后。
lines.en: I hide my two long arms behind me.

lines.zh: 你会不会觉得我很难看？
lines.en: Do you think I look awful?
I'm not very good at talking.
Your eyes keep watching me.
I hug my arms and curl up small.

lines.zh: 拟态兽退了几步，形状还在。
lines.en: The mimicmon backs off. Its shape holds.
The cloth got torn a bit.
I hunched my shoulders.
It hurts. Not good.
I can still stand for now.
I made a short sound.
I panicked all at once.
I need to back away.
That one left me bent over.
Food? I am a bit hungry.
That thing smells like bread.
Let me check it's not a trap.
Step back and I'll come eat it.
Move back and I'll dare take it.
I don't like being fed.
This smells all right.
What do you want for it?
Let me trade you something.
Thank you, but I don't need it.
I'll trade you something for it.
Move back and I'll come get it.
Oh, I'm really sorry.
I bump you and fall over first.
My arms are too long.
Don't back me into a corner.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起了，对不起。
lines.en: We got squeezed together; apologies.
I touched your hand.
You stepped on my cloth.
I'll just make some room.
It's really rather narrow here.
Closer and I'll get nervous.
I can't even figure myself out.
This body is a bit strange.
I haven't thought about that.
Don't ask about that.

lines.zh: 丛林里还有别的数码兽。
lines.en: There are other Digimon in this jungle.
I turn away and hug my knees.
I'm not good at talking about that.
I don't understand that.
I'm not what you take me for.

lines.zh: 我裹着布，长臂往后缩了一点。
lines.en: Wrapped in cloth, I pull my long arms back a little.
I pinch it with my fingertips.
This thing still works.
I sniff it and put it back.
I tuck it into my cloth.
It's very light to hold.
I haven't seen this before.

lines.zh: 拟态的样子，连羽毛都学。
lines.en: This mimic even copies the feathers.
It fell and rolled away.
You can have this.
I'll trade it for something else.
The crate lid over there just moved.

lines.zh: 那个柜子在动，我看见了。
lines.en: That cabinet moved; I saw it.
I flatten myself under the grass.
It's gone into the brush.
My arms can reach over there.

lines.zh: 先按兵不动，看它下一步。
lines.en: Hold still and watch its next move.
It seems to be watching me too.
I lean out from behind the cabinet.
That's a little far.
I spread my fingers as wide as they go.
It's coming this way.
I can get behind it.
It's still over there now.
I'm hidden behind the tree.
Its footsteps are regular.
I lie behind the roots.

lines.zh: 我学的样子，你分辨得出吗？
lines.en: I copy a shape; can you tell?

lines.zh: 它没注意到我，加特林臂收着。
lines.en: It has not noticed me; the Gatling arm is folded.
I stretch a long arm out slowly.
It seems to be looking elsewhere.
I shrank back.
This angle works.
It came a little closer.
Should I make my move.
I lash out with my long arm!
I sweep out with my cannon arm.
All three fingers claw at once.
That one got blocked.
I strike with both hands.
Two steps back in a row, good.

lines.zh: 我的指甲勾住你的衣角。
lines.en: My nail snags the hem of your coat.
I pull the arm back in.
I lunge wide and hit the wall.
I shout and charge again.
I panic and swing my claws wild.
I flail my long fingers wildly.
This is better than the End.
First I check the ground.
I stretch out my long thin limbs.

lines.zh: 我学谁像谁，可我不是他。
lines.en: I copy anyone, but I'm not them.
I hear something far away.
I straighten my cloth.
I crouch to tighten it.
Trees and grass all around.
I wrap the cloth tighter.
I haven't decided what to do.
There's someone else's smell.

lines.zh: 我从一个木箱里爬出来。
lines.en: I climb out of a wooden crate.
The cloth caught fire. I'm beating it out.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，摔得发懵。
lines.en: I fell from the tree and dazed myself.
Water soaked the cloth. Very heavy.
The blast threw me against the tree.

lines.zh: 有什么扎到了我的手臂。
lines.en: Something stuck in my arm.
That light left me dizzy.

lines.zh: 饿得我连说话都没力气。
lines.en: I'm too hungry to talk.
Lightning struck and I flinched.
Falling, and I can't grab anything.
